listing.tagline: Run the business side of your AI OS — HQ, command center, clients, pipeline and agencies in one place.
listing.description:
**Business & Agency** turns InfiniBot into the operating system for a business or an agency.

- **Business HQ** — today's focus, decision-ready items and progress across your whole business.
- **Command** — executive and operations views, the daily agency board, agencies and their topology.
- **Clients** — a CRM with invoicing and payment links.
- **Sales Pipeline** — leads moving through your stages to won deals.
- **Register** — opportunities, decisions, risks, commitments and people.
- **Leads & Funnels** — lead capture, the qualifier, funnels and campaigns.
- **Business settings** — your business profile and income sync (Whop, Stripe, Square keys are write-only settings).
- **Agency selector** in the top bar, plus the client-director, outreach, ledger, scout, briefer and monitor agents.

Works with the **Products** plugin when it is on (product cards on Business HQ). Turning the plugin off hides every page, the agency selector, the business agents and the business schedules; your data stays exactly where it is.
